g.text: R / mean(R) within the shown broad eta band
Reference panels pool broad eta bands; the width curves use 0.05-wide bins. Moments use all unbinned R, including tails.
Equal response bins of width 0.025; percentages use all band events. Empty bins are omitted on log-y; >3 counts are explicit.
